intents.title: Welcome to HeartGuard Medical GPT
intents.content:
Hello! 👋 I am HeartGuard Medical GPT, your offline healthcare and general wellness assistant.

Capabilities:
1. 🩺 Biomarker Analysis: Type lab values like BP 140/90, sugar 180, cholesterol 240, or SpO2 92% for instant medical interpretation.
2. 🫀 Cardiology & ECG: Heart attack warning signs, angina, arrhythmia, chest pain types, ST depression.
3. 🧠 Neurology & Pulmonology: Stroke F.A.S.T protocol, breathlessness, oxygen levels, migraine.
4. 💊 Pharmacology: Medications (Aspirin, Statins, Beta-blockers, ACE inhibitors).
5. 🥗 General Wellness: Stress relief, sleep hygiene, fever triage, hydration, and nutrition.

intents.title: Fever, Cold & Flu Care Protocol
intents.content:
A fever is a body temperature ≥100.4°F (38°C), indicating your immune system is fighting an infection.

Home Care Steps:
• 💧 Hydration: Drink water, warm broths, and oral rehydration fluids.
• 🛌 Rest: Allow body energy to combat viral activity.
• 💊 Fever Reducers: Over-the-counter Paracetamol (500mg) or Acetaminophen as per physician guidelines.

🚨 Red Flags: Seek immediate medical care if fever exceeds 103°F (39.4°C), lasts >3 days, or is accompanied by stiff neck, confusion, or difficulty breathing.

intents.title: Stress & Anxiety Reduction Techniques
intents.content:
Chronic stress elevates cortisol and epinephrine, increasing long-term hypertension and cardiac workload.

Immediate Relief Exercises:
1. 🫁 4-7-8 Breathing: Inhale through nose for 4s, hold for 7s, exhale slowly through mouth for 8s.
2. 🧘 Grounding (5-4-3-2-1 Technique): Identify 5 things you see, 4 you feel, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, 1 you taste.
3. 🏃 Physical Activity: A 15-minute walk burns off excess adrenaline.

If anxiety causes severe chest pressure or breathlessness, rule out cardiac issues at an emergency clinic.

intents.title: Sleep Hygiene & Rest Recovery
intents.content:
Adults require 7 to 9 hours of quality sleep nightly for cellular repair and cardiovascular regulation.

Sleep Optimization Tips:
• 📵 Screen Time: Avoid blue light screens 1 hour before bedtime.
• ☕ Caffeine Limit: Stop caffeine intake after 2:00 PM.
• 🛏️ Environment: Keep bedroom cool (65-68°F / 18-20°C) and completely dark.
• ⏰ Consistency: Maintain identical wake-up times every day.

intents.title: Gastroesophageal Reflux (GERD) vs Cardiac Discomfort
intents.content:
Acid reflux causes a burning feeling behind the breastbone (heartburn), often worsening after heavy meals or lying down.

Differentiating Acid Reflux from Heart Attack:
• GERD: Relieved by antacids or upright posture; burning sensation.
• 🚨 Heart Attack: Deep pressure, crushing sensation, radiating pain to left arm/jaw, sweating, unrelated to posture.

Tip: Avoid spicy/fatty foods, do not lie down within 3 hours after eating.

intents.title: Acute Myocardial Infarction (Heart Attack)
intents.content:
Severe crushing chest pressure, pain radiating to the left arm/shoulder/jaw, cold sweating, and acute shortness of breath indicate a life-threatening heart attack.

Immediate Protocol:
1. 📞 Call emergency services (108 / 911) immediately.
2. 🧘 Sit down and remain calm. Avoid physical exertion.
3. 💊 Chew an Aspirin 300mg if not allergic and advised by emergency dispatch.
4. 🚫 Do not drive yourself to the hospital.

intents.title: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure) Management
intents.content:
Normal BP is <120/80 mmHg. Stage 1 is 130-139/80-89 mmHg. Stage 2 is ≥140/90 mmHg.

Lifestyle Steps to Lower BP:
• 🥗 DASH Diet: Restrict sodium (<2g/day), increase potassium-rich foods (spinach, bananas).
• 🏃 Cardio Exercise: 30 minutes daily of brisk walking, cycling, or swimming.
• 🧘 Stress & Sleep: 7-8 hours of sleep and stress-reduction techniques.
• 💊 Medications: Consult a doctor regarding ACE inhibitors, Beta-blockers, or Calcium channel blockers if BP remains >140/90.

intents.title: Lipid Profile & Serum Cholesterol Control
intents.content:
Target Metrics:
• Total Cholesterol: <200 mg/dL
• LDL ('Bad' Cholesterol): <100 mg/dL (<70 mg/dL for high cardiac risk)
• HDL ('Good' Cholesterol): >40 mg/dL (men), >50 mg/dL (women)
• Triglycerides: <150 mg/dL

Management: Avoid trans fats, increase soluble fiber (oats, legumes, flaxseeds), omega-3 fatty acids, and take prescribed Statins under medical supervision.

intents.title: ECG & ST-Segment Analysis
intents.content:
An ECG records electrical signals passing through the heart.
• ST Depression (oldpeak > 1.5mm): Signals subendocardial myocardial ischemia during exercise or stress.
• ST Elevation (STEMI): Signals acute transmural myocardial infarction (Emergency).
• Resting ECG: Evaluates baseline rhythm, conduction blocks, and ventricular hypertrophy.

intents.title: Acute Stroke Warning (F.A.S.T. Protocol)
intents.content:
A Stroke is a brain emergency caused by a blood clot or burst vessel.

F.A.S.T. Warning Checklist:
• F (Face Drooping): One side of face droops when smiling.
• A (Arm Weakness): One arm drifts downward when raised.
• S (Speech Difficulty): Slurred or strange speech.
• T (Time to call 108/911): Immediate hospital arrival enables clot-busting medication (tPA) within 3-4.5 hours!

intents.title: Dizziness & Vertigo Assessment
intents.content:
Dizziness can stem from inner ear disorders (BPPV), sudden BP drop (orthostatic hypotension), dehydration, anemia, or cardiac arrhythmias.

Safety Advice: Sit or lie down immediately to prevent falls. Seek emergency care if accompanied by loss of speech, numbness, or chest pain.

intents.title: Dyspnea (Shortness of Breath) Evaluation
intents.content:
Breathlessness can originate from pulmonary causes (Asthma, COPD, Pneumonia, Pulmonary Embolism) or cardiac causes (Heart Failure, Pulmonary Edema).

Immediate Action: Sit upright, check SpO2 oxygen saturation (normal >95%). Seek immediate ER care if lips turn blue or accompanied by chest pain.

intents.title: Diabetes Mellitus & Blood Glucose Management
intents.content:
Target Ranges:
• Fasting Glucose (fbs): 70-99 mg/dL (Normal), 100-125 mg/dL (Prediabetes), ≥126 mg/dL (Diabetes).
• HbA1c: <5.7% (Normal), 5.7-6.4% (Prediabetes), ≥6.5% (Diabetes).

🚨 Hypoglycemia Alert (<70 mg/dL): Shakiness, sweating, confusion—immediately consume 15g fast-acting sugar (fruit juice, glucose candy).

intents.title: Aspirin (Antiplatelet Therapy)
intents.content:
Aspirin prevents blood platelets from clumping into clots inside narrowed coronary arteries.
• Emergency Heart Attack Dose: 300mg chewed immediately.
• Daily Secondary Prevention: 75-100mg daily under physician prescription.
